name: Gatekeeper Download Manager
author: cbshs

sections.description:
A professional cloud storage download and transfer system. Supports countdown timers and advertising placements, enhancing the monetization capabilities of download websites.

Features:
* Modern Download Gateway Page.
* Restricted Countdown (10s, 20s, 30s).
* Secure Nonce-protected redirects.
* Ad slot support.

Upgrade to Pro for:
* Email Subscription Unlock (Mailchimp/ConvertKit).
* Social Share to Unlock (X/Facebook).
* Custom Countdown (0-60s).
* Advanced Analytics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings in Settings -> Download Gate.

short_description: Professional download gateway with countdown and ad slots. Build your email list and increase ad revenue.
